notes.title: Release notes: Version 0.161.1
notes.content:
The update 0.161.1 integrates a few of the major improvements to the core engine to the game (more coming soon). These changes prepare a larger extension to be announced. Furthermore, a few minor bugfixes and performance improvements  have been done. FNA and its libs are updated, too. Have fun!

[list]
[*] Network multiplayer engine version 1.95 (internal beta testing)
[*] Fixed a rare bug with secret key collection
[*] Minor bug fixes
[*] Update to FNA 23.3 including full library update
[/list]

notes.content:

[/list]

notes.title: Release notes: Version 0.145.0
notes.content:
After an unfortunate long pause in development due to the Corona pandemic, we are now back in business and are now resuming the development of Hybrid Beasts with great momentum. We apologize for the long absence with a week-long 50% discount (starting September 18th, 10am PST), a small technical update with many minor bug fixes (live now) and more bigger updates coming soon.

[list]
[*] Update to FNA 21.09 and many other internal libraries
[*] Many minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: New Update 0.135 + New Feature: Random Events + 1st event: Asteroid Impact
notes.content:
We are happy to announce a new update 0.135 for Hybrid Beasts that adds a completely [b]new feature[/b] called "[b]Random Events[/b]". 

These random events are happening unexpectedly during a battle and have the potential to change the course of battle or drastically change fighting conditions. For example, in the first random event that is now available with the new update, a [b]deadly asteroid impacts the battlefield[/b] wreaking havok where it hits. Currently, only this one random event is available, but many more will be available, soon. The frequency and kind of random events can be controlled in the settings menu.

A number of further sound effects have been added.

Have fun!!

[previewyoutube=weuuxnkp9Ek;full][/previewyoutube]

PS: If you have any issues or problems with the new update, there is now the possibility to select the beta branch "former" to choose the previous game version instead of the newest. Please contact us at support@hybridbeasts.com if this is necessary such that we can fix the issue as fast as possible.

notes.title: New Update 0.134.7 + New Endgame: Acid Rain
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that the new update 0.134.7 for Hybrid Beasts adds a new endgame mode called "Acid Rain" where deadly poison is raining from the sky making it even more challenging to turn the tides in your favour during endgame. Hint: The mystery "When you dig deeper" must be solved to use the new endgame mode. 

A number of sound effects have been added, for example during endgame introduction.

Furthermore, we fixed the Metal API for Apple macOS systems solving a major graphics issue (Thanks FNA 20.10!). The much faster Metal API can now again be used instead of OpenGL on Apple systems.

Also, we fixed a few rare bugs, for example after repeated Laser or Super Laser use. As always, if you encounter a bug in the game, please post it in the Steam forums, or contact us directly at support@hybridbeasts.com - we will help as fast as possible.

Have fun!!

[previewyoutube=k5CWDCXN1iE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: New Update 0.134
notes.content:
The new update [b]0.134[/b] for [b]Hybrid Beasts[/b] adds major improvements to the [b]key/button binding[/b] in settings menu. You can now separately define gameplay and menu keys which now allows your favorite use of controls both when playing the game and when using menus.

Furthermore, the general usability of the settings menu has been improved.

The macOS version can now switch between OpenGL and Metal APIs. The latter is a bit faster but might suffer from some graphical glitches. We recommend to still use the defaut OpenGL version for now.

Also a few minor bugs were fixed. As always, if you still encounter a bug in the game, please post in the Steam forums, or contact us directly at support@hybridbeasts.com - we will help as fast as possible.

Have fun!!
